H5.38 introduces functional surface slot mapping as a planning layer after region mapping and cleanup.
Card frames are the first applied pilot; UI/HUD panels, dialogue panels, speech bubbles, buttons, progress bars, badges, and status panels are future targets.
Region mapping identifies an asset; cleanup prepares a visual candidate; functional slot mapping defines where dynamic content may later belong inside the asset.
All slots use relativeRect percentages inside a surface, not global runtime coordinates.
A bounded scale-up policy is recorded as a future fit response to overflow, but runtime scaling is not approved.
No runtime UI, text rendering, card gameplay, or Card Goblin Duel wiring is approved.
